rules.text: A valid photo identification is requested for all returns and exchanges with a receipt.
rules.quote: Valid photo identification is requested for all returns and exchanges.

rules.text: A refund will be issued in the same tender as the original purchase.
rules.quote: A refund will be issued in the same tender as the original purchase.

rules.text: Valid photo identification is required for all returns and exchanges without a receipt.
rules.quote: Valid photo identification is required for all returns and exchanges without a receipt.

rules.text: Returns without a receipt will receive store credit.
rules.quote: Returns without a receipt will receive store credit.

rules.text: The amount of store credit issued for returns without a receipt will be at the last sale price or marked down price.
rules.quote: The amount of credit issued will be at the last sale price or marked down price.

rules.text: Returns involving a gift receipt, store credit, Ticket to Shop, or merchandise voucher may only receive store credit, not a refund.
rules.quote: Store credit, but not a refund, may be issued for all returns involving a gift receipt, store credit, Ticket to Shop, merchandise voucher or certain other scrip.

rules.text: Items purchased online may be returned to any Big 5 Sporting Goods store with the original packing slip for a return or exchange.
rules.quote: Items purchased online from Big 5 Sporting Goods may be returned to any Big 5 Sporting Goods store with the original packing slip.

rules.text: Credit for online purchases returned in-store will be returned to the same credit card used for the purchase.
rules.quote: Credit will be returned to the same credit card used to make the online purchase.

rules.text: Customers should keep their receipt and ask to see the Store Manager if the receipt is not offered or the total does not match the amount paid.
rules.quote: If we fail to offer you a receipt, or if the total does not match the amount you paid, please ask to see the Store Manager before you leave.
